_llm_instructions: Fill out 'project_title' and 'date_prepared', and the 'value' property of each field, using the project context. Use the 'label' to select the correct output language for the target document. Reference parameters.md for global variables.

reporting_information.label: Reporting Information
reporting_information.guidance: Record the contractor, the contract number and type, the reporting period covered, and the report submission date. The contract type determines whether a cost forecast is expected.

scope_performance.label: Scope Performance
scope_performance.guidance: Describe the progress on scope made during this reporting period.

quality_performance.label: Quality Performance
quality_performance.guidance: Identify any quality or performance variances.

schedule_performance.label: Schedule Performance
schedule_performance.guidance: Describe whether the contract is on schedule. If ahead or behind, identify the cause of the variance.

cost_performance.label: Cost Performance
cost_performance.guidance: Describe whether the contract is on budget. If over or under budget, identify the cause of the variance.

forecast_performance.label: Forecast Performance
forecast_performance.guidance: Discuss the estimated delivery date and final cost of the contract. If the contract is fixed price, do not enter cost forecasts.

claims_or_disputes.label: Claims or Disputes
claims_or_disputes.guidance: Identify any new or resolved disputes or claims that occurred during the current reporting period.

risks.label: Risks
risks.guidance: List any risks. Risks should also be recorded in the project risk register.

corrective_preventive_action.label: Planned Corrective or Preventive Action
corrective_preventive_action.guidance: Identify planned corrective or preventive actions necessary to recover schedule, cost, scope, or quality variances.

issues.label: Issues
issues.guidance: Identify any new issues that have arisen. These should also be entered in the issue log.

escalations.label: Escalations
escalations.guidance: Identify any area that requires escalation to the sponsor, program manager, contracting officer, or another appropriate individual.

change_requests.label: Contract Change Requests
change_requests.guidance: Summarise any contract change requests submitted during this reporting period.

comments.label: Comments
comments.guidance: Add any comments that will add relevance to the report.
